```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ctmm)
# install.packages("ggnewscale")

checkpoint_dir <- "checkpoints"
utm_crs <- 32611

akde_test <- readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "akde_test.rds"))
dist_traffic_raster <- rast(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "dist_traffic_raster.tif"))
dense_id  <- "MVCOY68F"
sparse_id <- "MVBOB91M"
id_species <- c("MVCOY68F" = "Coyote", "MVBOB91M" = "Bobcat")  # ID -> species label
```

## Panel builder function

```{r akde-panel-fn}
make_akde_panel <- function(id, akde_list, fill_limits) {
  akde_95 <- as.sf(akde_list[[id]], level.UD = 0.95, level = 0.95) %>%
    filter(grepl("est$", name)) %>% st_transform(utm_crs) %>%
    mutate(level = "Full range (95%)")
  akde_50 <- as.sf(akde_list[[id]], level.UD = 0.50, level = 0.95) %>%
    filter(grepl("est$", name)) %>% st_transform(utm_crs) %>%
    mutate(level = "Core area (50%)")
  akde_home <- bind_rows(akde_50, akde_95)
  akde_home$level <- factor(akde_home$level, levels = c("Full range (95%)", "Core area (50%)"))

  buf <- st_buffer(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(akde_95)), dist = 500)  # crop margin, metres
  dist_crop <- crop(dist_traffic_raster, vect(buf))

  ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster(data = dist_crop) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#3f007d", "#807dba", "#bcbddc", "#f2f0f7"),
                          na.value = NA, name = "Dist. to\ntraffic\nroad (m)",
                          trans = "sqrt", limits = fill_limits) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_sf(data = akde_home, aes(fill = level), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Full range (95%)" = "#a6cee3", "Core area (50%)" = "#1f78b4"),
                       name = "Home range") +
    labs(title = paste0(id, " (", id_species[id], ")")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())
}
```

## Shared colour scale, computed across both individuals

```{r akde-shared-scale}
get_crop_max <- function(id, akde_list) {
  akde_95 <- as.sf(akde_list[[id]], level.UD = 0.95, level = 0.95) %>%
    filter(grepl("est$", name)) %>% st_transform(utm_crs)
  buf <- st_buffer(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(akde_95)), dist = 500)
  max(values(crop(dist_traffic_raster, vect(buf))), na.rm = TRUE)
}
shared_max <- max(get_crop_max(dense_id, akde_test), get_crop_max(sparse_id, akde_test))
shared_limits <- c(0, shared_max)                     # same limits used on both panels
```

## Comparison plot

```{r akde-traffic-compare, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
panel_dense  <- make_akde_panel(dense_id, akde_test, shared_limits)
panel_sparse <- make_akde_panel(sparse_id, akde_test, shared_limits)

panel_dense + panel_sparse +
  plot_annotation(title = "Home range against traffic-exposure surface",
                   subtitle = "Core (dark) vs full range (light). Same colour scale on both panels.")
```
